import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import os
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.ensemble import GradientBoostingClassifier
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# Create submission directory if it doesn't exist
os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)

# Load data
print("Loading data...")
train_df = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")
sample_submission = pd.read_csv("./input/sample_submission_null.csv")

# Check data shapes
print(f"Train shape: {train_df.shape}")
print(f"Test shape: {test_df.shape}")
print(f"Sample submission shape: {sample_submission.shape}")
print(f"Sample submission columns: {sample_submission.columns.tolist()}")


# Text preprocessing - clean escaped characters
def clean_text(text):
    if pd.isna(text):
        return ""
    # Handle escaped characters like \n, \t, etc.
    text = text.replace("\\n", "\n").replace("\\t", "\t").replace("\\r", "")
    # Remove extra whitespace
    text = " ".join(text.split())
    return text


print("Preprocessing text...")
train_df["cleaned_text"] = train_df["Comment"].apply(clean_text)
test_df["cleaned_text"] = test_df["Comment"].apply(clean_text)

# Create hold-out validation split (model will never see this during training)
print("Creating validation split...")
X_train_texts, X_val_texts, y_train, y_val = train_test_split(
    train_df["cleaned_text"].values,
    train_df["Insult"].values,
    test_size=0.2,
    random_state=42,
    stratify=train_df["Insult"],
)

# Word-level TF-IDF vectorization to capture semantic meaning
print("Creating word-level TF-IDF features...")
word_vectorizer = TfidfVectorizer(
    analyzer="word",
    ngram_range=(1, 2),
    max_features=5000,
    min_df=2,
    max_df=0.95,
    sublinear_tf=True,
)
X_train_word = word_vectorizer.fit_transform(X_train_texts)
X_val_word = word_vectorizer.transform(X_val_texts)
X_test_word = word_vectorizer.transform(test_df["cleaned_text"])

# Character-level TF-IDF vectorization for patterns
print("Creating character-level TF-IDF features...")
char_vectorizer = TfidfVectorizer(
    analyzer="char_wb",
    ngram_range=(2, 3),
    max_features=10000,
    min_df=2,
    max_df=0.95,
    sublinear_tf=True,
)
X_train_char = char_vectorizer.fit_transform(X_train_texts)
X_val_char = char_vectorizer.transform(X_val_texts)
X_test_char = char_vectorizer.transform(test_df["cleaned_text"])

# Concatenate features: word features + character features
print("Concatenating features...")
X_train_combined = np.hstack([X_train_word.toarray(), X_train_char.toarray()])
X_val_combined = np.hstack([X_val_word.toarray(), X_val_char.toarray()])
X_test_combined = np.hstack([X_test_word.toarray(), X_test_char.toarray()])

# Train Logistic Regression classifier
print("Training Logistic Regression classifier...")
lr_model = LogisticRegression(
    max_iter=1000,
    solver="lbfgs",
    random_state=42,
)
lr_model.fit(X_train_combined, y_train)

# Train Gradient Boosting classifier on training data only
print("Training Gradient Boosting classifier...")
gbm_model = GradientBoostingClassifier(
    n_estimators=150,
    learning_rate=0.1,
    max_depth=3,
    min_samples_split=20,
    min_samples_leaf=10,
    subsample=0.8,
    random_state=42,
)
gbm_model.fit(X_train_combined, y_train)

# Validate on hold-out set (model never trained on this data)
print("Validating on hold-out set...")
lr_val_pred = lr_model.predict_proba(X_val_combined)[:, 1]
gbm_val_pred = gbm_model.predict_proba(X_val_combined)[:, 1]
ensemble_val_pred = 0.5 * lr_val_pred + 0.5 * gbm_val_pred
val_auc = roc_auc_score(y_val, ensemble_val_pred)
print(f"Validation AUC-ROC (Ensemble): {val_auc:.6f}")

# Train final ensemble models on full training data (separate from validation)
print("Training final ensemble models on full training data...")
final_lr_model = LogisticRegression(
    max_iter=1000,
    solver="lbfgs",
    random_state=42,
)
final_lr_model.fit(X_train_combined, y_train)

final_gbm_model = GradientBoostingClassifier(
    n_estimators=200,
    learning_rate=0.08,
    max_depth=4,
    min_samples_split=15,
    min_samples_leaf=8,
    subsample=0.8,
    random_state=42,
)
final_gbm_model.fit(X_train_combined, y_train)

# Generate predictions for test set
print("Generating test predictions...")
lr_test_pred = final_lr_model.predict_proba(X_test_combined)[:, 1]
gbm_test_pred = final_gbm_model.predict_proba(X_test_combined)[:, 1]
test_preds = 0.5 * lr_test_pred + 0.5 * gbm_test_pred

# Create submission file with correct format matching sample_submission_null.csv
print("Saving submission file...")
submission_df = pd.DataFrame(
    {"Insult": test_preds, "Date": test_df["Date"], "Comment": test_df["Comment"]}
)
submission_df = submission_df[["Insult", "Date", "Comment"]]
submission_df.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)
print(f"Submission saved to ./submission/submission.csv")
print(f"Submission shape: {submission_df.shape}")
print(f"Submission columns: {submission_df.columns.tolist()}")
print(f"Prediction range: [{test_preds.min():.4f}, {test_preds.max():.4f}]")
print(f"Mean prediction: {test_preds.mean():.4f}")

# Also print the validation metric for the hold-out set
print(f"Validation AUC-ROC (hold-out): {val_auc:.6f}")
